About.title: About
About.metaDescription: About BYH Electronic Watch Co., Ltd. — precision engineering, smart wearables, and children's watches from Dongguan, China.
About.intro1: Welcome to BYH Electronic Watch Co., Ltd., a premier manufacturer dedicated to precision engineering, innovative design, and high-quality wearable technology.
About.intro2: Strategically located at No. 8, Jinshagang 6th Road, Dongguan, China, our company brings together more than 20 years of solid manufacturing expertise. We originated as a precision mold-making specialist—a unique foundation that gives us complete in-house control over structural integrity, tooling precision, and rapid product development. Over the years, we have leveraged this core strength to evolve into a full-service manufacturer specializing in digital timepieces, smart wearables, and creative children's watches.
About.strength1: Rooted in our two-decade mold-making heritage, every product undergoes strict quality control from raw tooling and injection molding to final electronic assembly.
About.strength2: We design and produce modern digital and smart wristbands featuring vibrant LED/OLED displays, intuitive interfaces, and practical daily health/activity tracking.
About.strength3: Designed with fun, safety, and durability in mind, our children's range includes touch-activated digital watches, multi-functional keychain/clip-on watches, and interchangeable graphic-face designs using skin-friendly, shock-resistant materials.
About.strength4: With complete end-to-end capabilities—from ID design and mold development to PCBA integration and custom packaging—we provide flexible, reliable OEM and ODM solutions for global brands.
About.closing: At BYH Electronic Watch Co., Ltd., we combine our manufacturing craftsmanship with modern smart technology to deliver durable, stylish, and dependable timepieces to clients worldwide.
